activities.title: Morning Walk & Day Planner
activities.description: Take a 15‑minute brisk walk outdoors while using a simple notebook to timebox your tasks for the day in 30‑minute blocks.

activities.title: Park Decision Sprint
activities.description: At a local park, set a timer for 5 minutes and list three choices you need to make, then pick the best option before the timer ends.

activities.title: Bodyweight HIIT Circuit
activities.description: Perform a 20‑minute indoor bodyweight HIIT routine, breaking the session into four 5‑minute timeboxed intervals with 30‑second rests.

activities.title: Visual Timebox Board Creation
activities.description: Spend 30 minutes drawing a visual board that maps out your weekly goals using colored blocks to represent timeboxed periods.
